notes.title: Desktop Garage Kit 1.0.7 Update - Sep 17, 2023. 8K resolution rendering support!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44533354/2a30f74d6c21d6f7f7cbb7e7d86516cda63edf52.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Added support for 8K resolution rendering!
[*] Quick resolution switching options added to MiniPanel and Setting panel.
[*] Now supports rendering at 8K resolution.
[*] [b]💓Friendly reminder: If your display does not support 4K or 8K, please restart the app to restore rendering at the maximum supported resolution for your display.[/b]
[*] UI Interaction Enhancement makes navigation smoother and more intuitive.
[*] Other bug fixes.
[/list]
